title: Preprocessing contract of one benchmark entry

entry.description: detector or method name as on the leaderboard

subset.description: table the entry belongs to (e.g. U, M, both)

code_commit.description: commit of the code that produced the entry's results

scope.description: unit over which statistics are computed

statistics_from.description: data the statistics come from (window, training part, whole series, ...)

fit_score.description: whether fitting and scoring apply the same transform with the same statistics
